learnings: Best risk-adjusted sleeves that worked in both 2008-2018 and 2019+: Dairy trend basket: 20-day breakouts in milk, cheese, butter, powder, whey (Sharpe 1.63, 2019+ 1.3, max DD -12.6%, Calmar 1.4); Blend: equal risk of the 11 sleeves with Sharpe > 0.3 in 2008-2018 (Sharpe 0.91, 2019+ 0.98, max DD -21.2%, Calmar 0.46); Trend, every market long if up / short if down over 4-week (Sharpe 0.88, 2019+ 1.42, max DD -17.0%, Calmar 0.53); Strong uptrends long (price > 50 > 200-day), downtrends short (Sharpe 0.79, 2019+ 0.93, max DD -27.1%, Calmar 0.28); Trend blend: average of 1, 3, 6 and 12-month signals (Sharpe 0.73, 2019+ 1.04, max DD -26.5%, Calmar 0.26).

Lowest drawdown per unit of return (Calmar), both periods positive: Dairy trend basket: 20-day breakouts in milk, cheese, butter, powder, whey (Calmar 1.4, max DD -12.6%, hit 59.8%); Trend, every market long if up / short if down over 4-week (Calmar 0.53, max DD -17.0%, hit 53.6%); Blend: equal risk of the 11 sleeves with Sharpe > 0.3 in 2008-2018 (Calmar 0.46, max DD -21.2%, hit 56.2%); Strong uptrends long (price > 50 > 200-day), downtrends short (Calmar 0.28, max DD -27.1%, hit 55.0%); Long backwardated uptrends, short contangoed downtrends (Calmar 0.28, max DD -24.1%, hit 55.1%).

Did not work: Short-term reversal: long last week's losers, short winners (Sharpe -0.8); Follow 4-week spec flow (cross-section) (Sharpe -0.37); Liquidity provision: short last week's biggest spec buying, long the biggest selling (Sharpe -0.36); Skewness: long most negatively skewed, short most positively skewed (52 weeks) (Sharpe -0.31).
Blend of the sleeves picked on 2008-2018 only: Sharpe 0.98 in 2019+ (vs 0.86 in-sample), max DD -21.2%, worst week -7.15% at 10% vol.
